authority_command: for s in closed in_progress open blocked grading; do br list --status "$s" --json | jq -r 'if type == "array" then length elif .issues then (.issues|length) else error("unexpected br JSON shape") end'; done | awk '{s += $1} END {print s}'
failure_result: CROSS_SECTION_BOARD_AUTHORITY_FAILURE: command or status enumeration failed
consumer: 00-brief board_total citations and fresh reader
notes: LIVE figure; never freeze the board total. The five status buckets are the complete scope.

authority_scope: docs/plan/04-diagrams.md Diagram 4 and its generator paragraph
failure_result: CROSS_SECTION_GENERATOR_ACCEPTANCE_FAILURE: missing owner, command, or changed-edge RED leg
consumer: future diagram generator and CI freshness check
notes: The generator itself remains PROJECTED; this row makes its owner, acceptance command, and failure result explicit instead of claiming it exists.

failure_result: CROSS_SECTION_CLI_STATUS_FAILURE: a projected command was presented as an existing runtime surface
consumer: fresh reader and future canonical CLI gate
notes: The resident run entrypoint exists; adopter-facing doctor/init/repair remains PROJECTED unless source and executable receipt say otherwise.

authority_scope: Cargo workspace metadata plus crates directory
authority_command: cargo metadata --format-version 1 --no-deps --offline | jq -c "[.packages[] | select(.manifest_path | contains(\"/crates/\"))] | length"
failure_result: CROSS_SECTION_EXTRACTION_STATE_FAILURE: metadata and on-disk crate scope disagree
consumer: 03-crates.md and AGENTS.md
notes: EXISTS means the checked-in crate directories and metadata are present; it does not mean every runtime journey is shipped.

authority_scope: docs/plan/FOUNDATION.jsonl stages S1-S9 and SCHEMAS.toml artifacts.journey_foundation
failure_result: CROSS_SECTION_LIFECYCLE_AUTHORITY_FAILURE: missing stage row or schema field
consumer: no-shell-gate schemas/foundation readers
notes: The foundation artifact exists. Its rows explicitly distinguish exists=false projected mechanisms from exists=true crates.

failure_result: CROSS_SECTION_COMPLETION_AUTHORITY_FAILURE: writer/consumer absent but wording claims wired
writer: upstream AgentEndEvent and br close rows
consumer: local AgentEndEvent parser/consumer is absent; reap sweep is separate
notes: This is explicitly unproven at the local consumer seam. No completion or runtime shipping claim is made.

notes: The gate test targets exist and are exercised by cargo test; any historical leg counts remain explicitly historical and are not semantic coverage claims.
